heroSubtitle: Learn how SetupZoneDubai Operated by Brightlink collects, uses, and protects your personal information. Your privacy is our priority.

sidebarCard.title: Privacy Concerns?
sidebarCard.text: Contact us for any privacy-related questions.

intro.heading: Introduction
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy (hereinafter referred to as the "Policy") governs the manner in which SetupZoneDubai Operated by Brightlink and its affiliates (collectively referred to as "SetupZoneDubai", "we", "us", or "our") collect, use, maintain, and disclose personal information. It also explains your rights regarding access, correction, and control of your personal data.
This Policy applies to all personal information and aggregated information collected through our website (the "Website"), and must be read in conjunction with our Terms of Use.
intro.importantNote: By accessing, browsing, or using this Website and/or obtaining any services from us, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of this Policy. If you do not agree, please refrain from using or accessing the Website.

section01.label: Section 01
section01.title: Information Collection & Usage
section01.intro: While using our Website, we may ask you to provide us with certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify you. Therefore, we may gather two types of information about you:

personalInfo.title: Personal Information
personalInfo.text: Personal information including but not limited to, your name, address, phone number, email address, date of birth, and payment information, which may be collected from you when you voluntarily provide the same through the following methods:
items: Registering and creating a membership account
Participating in surveys and other promotions available on the Website
Communicating with us through Contact Us, Live Chat, or telephone
Interaction on our social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn)
Other sources such as third parties where reasonably necessary for our business practices

aggregateInfo.title: Aggregate Information
aggregateInfo.text: Aggregate information is generated by SetupZoneDubai's systems, which is not directly related to you personally. Whenever you interact with SetupZoneDubai Products and/or Services, we automatically receive and record information on our server logs including your IP address, device identification "cookie" information, browser/device type, and page or feature you requested.

section01.note: Failure to provide necessary personal information when requested may result in certain services not being available to you.

section02.label: Section 02
section02.title: Disclosure of Information
section02.intro: SetupZoneDubai may disclose Personal Information about you provided you have granted authority for the following:
items: To disclose with our affiliates worldwide, licensees and joint venture partners for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy
Any information that it gathers about you to third parties for the purposes of providing you with services that you request
Aggregate tracking information and other information that does not personally identify you to third parties
Your personal information to third parties, when SetupZoneDubai believes in good faith that it is required to do so by law or legal process
Your authorized personal information to third parties which shall be obtained at the time of collecting the information from you

section03.label: Section 03
section03.title: Use of Information
section03.intro: SetupZoneDubai shall use the personal information it collects:
items: To verify your identity and assist you if you forget your password or login details
To assist in providing the services requested by you
To provide further information about other websites and services which SetupZoneDubai considers may be of interest to you
For future marketing, promotional and publicity purposes, including direct marketing, market research and surveys
For internal purposes, development and administration of our sites, data analytics, and compliance with our legal obligations
For ensuring that you are shown the information that is most relevant to you and your interests
To prevent and detect any misuse of, or fraudulent activities; and for any other use that you authorize

section04.label: Section 04
section04.title: Cookies & Tracking
paragraphs: This Website uses a "Cookies and Tracking" file that is transferred to your computer's hard drive, which can identify details of your IP address, operating system, browser, locale, and other user information.

cookieUses.title: SetupZoneDubai may use cookies to:
items: Track traffic patterns to and from the Website
Ensure any advertising is being shown to the most appropriate person
Enable you to enter the Website and use certain services

section04.note: Should you wish to refuse to accept cookies, you may choose to disable it in your browser. However, some web pages may not function properly should the cookies be disabled.
section04.analyticsText: SetupZoneDubai's use of Google Analytics is in compliance with Google's Terms of Service and this Privacy Policy.

section05.label: Section 05
section05.title: Content Providers, Advertisers & Partners
section05.text: This Privacy Policy shall not be applicable to other third-party websites to which we may link. SetupZoneDubai is not responsible for the data collection practices, privacy policies or the contents of other websites other than this Website. You should contact the operators of that particular website directly should you wish to enquire about their privacy practices.

section06.label: Section 06
section06.title: Opting In and Out
section06.intro: Should SetupZoneDubai's intended collection, use or disclosure of your personal information be outside the collection, use or disclosure set out in this Privacy Policy, SetupZoneDubai shall provide you the option to:

options.title: Opt Out
options.desc: Neither receive certain services nor participate in certain interactive areas

options.title: Opt In
options.desc: Agree to be contacted in relation to certain matters such as notification of new features, beta testing or promotional activities

section07.label: Section 07
section07.title: Protecting Your Personal Information
paragraphs: The security of your personal information is important to SetupZoneDubai. We recognize industry standards and practice appropriate administrative, technical and physical security safeguards to protect your personal information.
section07.importantNote: No method of transmission over the Internet, or method of electronic storage, is 100% secure. SetupZoneDubai shall not guarantee the absolute security of your personal information.

section08.label: Section 08
section08.title: Disclosure of Information Overseas
section08.text: We may require to transfer your collected personal information to countries other than the country in which you originally provided the information. These countries may not have the same data protection laws. When we transfer your information to other countries, SetupZoneDubai shall protect that information as described in this Privacy Notice.

section09.label: Section 09
section09.title: Holding, Correcting & Updating Information
section09.text: We offer you the ability to correct or change the information collected at any time and as often as necessary, with the exception of certain restricted data fields. Where you wish to amend a restricted data field or have any questions, please contact SetupZoneDubai Customer Service.

section10.label: Section 10
section10.title: Amendments
section10.text: SetupZoneDubai reserves the right to change this Privacy Policy at any time and without providing you notice. Your continued use of the Website constitutes your acceptance of the modified Privacy Policy.

section11.label: Section 11
section11.title: Acceptance
section11.text: By using SetupZoneDubai's Website, you signify your acceptance to this Policy.

section12.label: Section 12
section12.title: How to Contact Us
section12.intro: If you have any questions or comments regarding our privacy practices, contact us:
section12.whatsappMessage: Hi! I have a privacy-related question.

items.q: How much does it cost to start a business in Dubai?
items.a: Business setup in Dubai starts from AED 9,500 for a basic free zone license. Mainland setup starts from AED 14,500.

items.q: Can a foreigner 100% own a company in Dubai?
items.a: Yes, foreigners can 100% own companies in most free zones and many mainland activities.

items.q: What is the cheapest free zone in Dubai?
items.a: RAK ICC, Ajman FTZ, and SRTIP offer the most affordable packages starting from AED 5,900.

items.q: How long does company registration take in Dubai?
items.a: Free zone registration takes 3-7 business days. Mainland takes 2-4 weeks.

items.q: Do I need a local partner in Dubai?
items.a: Not in free zones. In mainland, many activities now allow 100% foreign ownership.
